translations.literal: The officials who govern the people attend to almost nothing else; vulgar clerks, shallow and near-sighted, still cling to the usual statutes, relying on old rules of exhortation and supervision and losing sight of how popular conditions have repeatedly changed.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials attend to almost nothing else; shallow petty clerks still cling to the old statutes, enforcing ancient rules of exhortation and supervision while blind to how conditions among the people have changed again and again.

sentences.zh: 譬猶修堤以防川，忘淵丘之改易；

translations.literal: It is like repairing dikes to hold back a river while forgetting that deep pools and mounds have shifted;
translations.idiomatic: It is like repairing dikes against a flood while forgetting that the riverbed itself has shifted;

sentences.zh: 膠柱於昔弦，忽宮商之乖調。

translations.literal: or fixing the peg to an old string and ignoring that gong and shang are out of tune.
translations.idiomatic: or fixing the peg to an old string and ignoring that the pitch has gone wrong.

sentences.zh: 徒有考課之條，而無毫分之益。

translations.literal: There are only rules for examination and assessment, yet not the slightest benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Examination rules abound, yet not the slightest benefit follows.

sentences.zh: 不悟清流在於澄源，止輪由乎高閎，患生於本，治之於末故也。

translations.literal: They do not realize that clear streams come from purifying the source and that stopping a wheel depends on the height of the barrier; the trouble arises at the root, yet they treat the branches.
translations.idiomatic: They do not see that clear water comes from purifying the source and that a wheel is stopped at the sluice gate; the trouble begins at the root, yet they treat only the branches.

sentences.zh: 夫設位以崇賢，疏爵以命士，上量能以審官，不取人於浮譽，則比周道息，游者言歸；

translations.literal: Establish posts to honor the worthy, distribute ranks to appoint gentlemen, measure capacity to examine officials, and do not take men from empty reputation—then factional collusion ceases and wanderers speak of returning home;
translations.idiomatic: Establish posts to honor the worthy, distribute ranks to appoint gentlemen, measure capacity when appointing officials, and refuse empty reputation—then factional collusion dies away and wanderers speak of going home;

sentences.zh: 游子既歸，則南畝闢矣。

translations.literal: when the wanderers return, the southern fields are opened.
translations.idiomatic: when the wanderers return, the southern fields are opened.

sentences.zh: 分職以任務，置吏以周役，職不以無任立，吏必以非用省，冗散者廢，則萊荒墾矣。

translations.literal: Divide duties to assign tasks and appoint clerks to complete service. Let no office stand without responsibility and cut clerks wherever they serve no use; abolish the redundant and idle, and fallow wilderness is reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Divide duties by task and appoint clerks to complete service. Let no office stand without real responsibility and cut clerks wherever they serve no use; abolish the redundant, and fallow land is reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 器以應用，商以通財，剿靡麗之巧，棄難得之貨，則雕偽者賤，穀稼重矣。

translations.literal: Let vessels serve use and commerce circulate wealth; cut away ornate refinements and discard hard-to-obtain goods—then the carved and counterfeit are cheap and grain is valued.
translations.idiomatic: Let tools serve use and trade circulate wealth; cut away ornate refinements and discard rare luxuries—then the gaudy and counterfeit grow cheap and grain is prized.

sentences.zh: 耕耨勤悴，力殷收寡，工商逸豫，用淺利深，增賈販之稅，薄疇畝之賦，則末技抑而田畯喜矣。

translations.literal: In plowing and hoeing men toil exhaustedly yet harvest little, while craftsmen and merchants live at ease with shallow outlay and deep profit. Increase taxes on trade and reduce levies on fields—then secondary crafts are checked and field overseers rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers toil in plowing and hoeing yet harvest little, while craftsmen and merchants live at ease with shallow outlay and deep profit. Raise taxes on trade and lighten field levies—then secondary crafts are checked and field overseers rejoice.

sentences.zh: 居位無義從之徒，在野靡兼併之黨，給賜非可恩致，力役不入私門，則游食者反本，肆勤自勸；

translations.literal: Let those in office have no hangers-on without cause, and in the countryside let there be no factions of land-grabbing; grants and gifts must not come through favor, and corvée must not enter private gates—then idlers return to the root and the diligent encourage themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Let officeholders have no hangers-on without cause, and in the countryside let there be no land-grabbing factions; grants must not come through favor, and corvée must not enter private gates—then idlers return to their roots and the diligent encourage themselves;

sentences.zh: 游食省而肆勤眾，則東作繁矣。

translations.literal: when idlers are reduced and the diligent grow numerous, eastern fieldwork flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: when idlers are reduced and the diligent grow numerous, spring planting flourishes.

sentences.zh: 密勿者甄異，怠慢者顯罰，明勸課之令，峻糾違之官，則懶惰無所容，力田有所望；

translations.literal: Select and distinguish the diligent, visibly punish the slack, make clear the orders for exhortation and assessment, and tighten the officials who correct violations—then laziness has no refuge and those who work the fields have hope;
translations.idiomatic: Reward the diligent and visibly punish the slack, make clear the orders for exhortation and assessment, and tighten the officials who correct violations—then laziness has no refuge and those who work the fields have hope;

sentences.zh: 力者欣而惰者懼，則穡人勸矣。

translations.literal: when the strong rejoice and the lazy fear, farmers are encouraged.
translations.idiomatic: when the strong rejoice and the lazy fear, farmers are encouraged.

sentences.zh: 凡此數事，亦務田之端趣也。

translations.literal: All these several measures are also the first steps toward making agriculture the priority.
translations.idiomatic: All these measures are the first steps toward making agriculture the priority.

sentences.zh: 蒞之以清心，鎮之以無欲，勖之以無倦，翼之以廉謹，舍日計之小成，期遠致於莫歲，則澆薄自淳，心化有漸矣。

translations.literal: Approach it with a pure heart, steady it with lack of desire, encourage it with tirelessness, and support it with integrity and caution. Set aside small gains counted by the day and look to distant achievement in years to come—then frivolity of itself grows sincere and moral transformation advances by degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Approach it with a pure heart, steady it with lack of desire, encourage it with tirelessness, and support it with integrity and caution. Set aside small daily gains and look to achievement years hence—then frivolity of itself grows sincere and moral transformation advances by degrees.

sentences.zh: 豹善言雅俗，每商較古今，兼以誦詠，聽者忘疲。

translations.literal: Bao was skilled at discourse on refined and common matters; whenever he compared past and present and added recitation and song, listeners forgot their fatigue.
translations.idiomatic: Bao was a gifted talker on matters high and low; when he compared past and present and added recitation and song, listeners forgot their fatigue.

sentences.zh: 尋轉撫軍司馬，遷御史中丞。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Major of the Pacifying Army and promoted to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became major of the Pacifying Army and was promoted censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽縣侯孟懷玉上母檀氏拜國太夫人，有司奏許。

translations.literal: Marquis of Poyang County Meng Huaiyu petitioned that his mother, Lady Tan, be granted the title Grand Lady of the State; the relevant offices memorialized approval.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Huaiyu, marquis of Poyang County, petitioned that his mother Lady Tan be granted the title Grand Lady of the State; the relevant offices memorialized approval.

sentences.zh: 豹以為婦人從夫之爵，懷玉父大司農綽見居列卿，妻不宜從子，奏免尚書右僕射劉柳、左丞徐羨之、郎何邵之官，詔並贖論。

translations.literal: Bao held that a woman's rank follows her husband's; Huaiyu's father Chuo, Grand Minister of Agriculture, already stood among the chief ministers, so his wife ought not follow her son. He memorialized dismissal of Vice Director of the Right Liu Liu, Left Assistant Director Xu Xianzhi, and Gentleman He Shao; an edict restored all by commutation.
translations.idiomatic: Bao held that a woman's rank follows her husband's; Huaiyu's father Chuo, Grand Minister of Agriculture, already stood among the chief ministers, so his wife ought not follow her son. He memorialized the dismissal of Vice Director Liu Liu, Left Assistant Director Xu Xianzhi, and Gentleman He Shao; an edict restored all by commutation.

sentences.zh: 孟昶卒，豹代為丹陽尹。

translations.literal: When Meng Chang died, Bao replaced him as Governor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Meng Chang died, Bao succeeded him as governor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 義熙七年，坐使徙上錢，降為太尉諮議參軍，仍轉長史。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yixi he was demoted for sending up money from relocation levies, reduced to Advising Staff Officer to the Grand Commandant, then transferred to Chief Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yixi he was demoted for misusing relocation funds, reduced to advising staff officer to the Grand Commandant, then chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 從討劉毅。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Liu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Liu Yi.

sentences.zh: 高祖遣益州刺史朱齡石伐蜀，使豹為檄文，曰：

translations.literal: The High Ancestor sent Zhu Ling, Inspector of Yi Province, to campaign against Shu and had Bao draft the proclamation, which read:
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor sent Zhu Ling, inspector of Yi Province, to campaign against Shu and had Bao draft the proclamation, which read:

sentences.zh: 夫順德者昌，逆德者亡，失仁與義，難以求安，馮阻負釁，鮮克有成。

translations.literal: Those who follow virtue flourish; those who oppose virtue perish. Lose benevolence and righteousness and peace is hard to obtain; rely on barriers and bear guilt, and few succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who follow virtue flourish; those who oppose it perish. Without benevolence and righteousness peace is impossible; those who rely on barriers and bear guilt seldom succeed.

sentences.zh: 詳觀自古，隆替有數，故成都不世祀，華陽無興國。

translations.literal: Looking closely from antiquity, rise and fall follow a fixed pattern; hence Chengdu has never enjoyed lasting sacrifice, and Huayang has never produced a state that endured.
translations.idiomatic: Look closely through history: rise and fall follow a pattern. Chengdu has never known lasting rule, and Huayang has never produced a state that endured.

sentences.zh: 日者王室多故，夷羿遘紛，波振塵駭，覃及遐裔。

translations.literal: Recently the royal house suffered many troubles; Yi brought chaos, waves shook and dust alarmed, and the shock reached distant lands.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the royal house suffered many troubles; rebellion brought chaos, shock spread far and wide, and the tremor reached distant lands.

sentences.zh: 蕞爾譙縱，編戶黔首，同惡相求，是崇是長，肆反噬於州相，播毒害於民黎，俾我西服，隔閡皇澤。

translations.literal: The petty Qiao Zong, a mere registered commoner, sought out fellow evildoers, exalted and nurtured them, wantonly turned on provincial governors, spread poison among the people, and cut off our western provinces from the imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: The petty Qiao Zong, a mere registered commoner, gathered fellow evildoers, exalted and nurtured them, turned on provincial governors, spread poison among the people, and cut off our western provinces from imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 自義風電靡，天光反輝，昭晢舊物，煙煴區宇。

translations.literal: Since the wind of righteousness swept like lightning and heaven's light shone again, old institutions were clarified and the realm glowed with renewal.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wind of righteousness swept like lightning and heaven's light returned, old institutions were restored and the realm glowed with renewal.

sentences.zh: 以庶務草創，未遑九伐，自爾以來，奄延十載。

translations.literal: Because myriad affairs were still being founded, there was no leisure for the nine punitive campaigns; from then until now nearly ten years have passed.
translations.idiomatic: Because myriad affairs were still being founded, there was no leisure for full-scale punishment; from then until now nearly ten years have passed.

sentences.zh: 而野心不革，伺隙乘間，招聚逋叛，共相封殖，侵擾我蠻獠，搖盪我疆垂。

translations.literal: Yet his wild heart did not change; watching for openings and seizing intervals, he gathered deserters and rebels, mutually entrenched themselves, harassed our frontier tribes, and shook our borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his wild heart did not change; watching for openings and seizing intervals, he gathered deserters and rebels, entrenched themselves together, harassed our frontier tribes, and shook our borders.

sentences.zh: 我是以有治洲之役，醜類盡殪，匹馬無遺，桓謙折首，譙福鳥逝，奔伏窠穴，引頸待戮。

translations.literal: Hence there was the Zhizhou campaign: the wicked were all destroyed, not a horse remained, Huan Qian was beheaded, Qiao Fu fled like a bird, crouched in their lairs, and stretched their necks awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Zhizhou campaign: the wicked were destroyed to the last horse, Huan Qian was beheaded, Qiao Fu fled like a bird, and the rest crouched in their lairs with necks outstretched awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 當今北狄露晞，南寇埃掃，朝風載韙，庶績其凝，康哉之歌日熙，比屋之隆可詠。

translations.literal: Today the northern barbarians are dissolving like dew, southern rebels are swept away like dust, the court's wind carries goodness, myriad achievements are gathering, songs of peace grow daily brighter, and prosperity in every house is fit to be praised.
translations.idiomatic: Today the northern barbarians are dissolving like dew, southern rebels are swept away like dust, the court's wind carries goodness, achievements are gathering, songs of peace grow daily brighter, and prosperity in every house is fit to praise.

sentences.zh: 孤職是經略，思一九有，眷彼禹跡，願言載懷，奉命西行，途戾荊、郢，瞻望巴、漢，憤慨交深。

translations.literal: I am charged with the grand strategy, thinking to unify the realm; cherishing that land traced by Yu, my longing fills my breast. Ordered to march west, our route touches Jing and Ying; gazing toward Ba and Han, indignation and resolve deepen together.
translations.idiomatic: I am charged with the grand strategy, thinking to unify the realm; cherishing the land traced by Yu, my longing fills my breast. Ordered to march west, our route touches Jing and Ying; gazing toward Ba and Han, indignation and resolve deepen together.

sentences.zh: 清江源於濫觴，澄氛祲於井絡，誅叛柔遠，今也其時。

translations.literal: The clear river has its source in a tiny spring; purify the baleful vapors at Jingluo—punish rebels and soothe the distant. Now is the time.
translations.idiomatic: The clear river begins at a tiny spring; purify the baleful vapors at Jingluo—punish rebels and soothe the distant. Now is the time.

sentences.zh: 即命河間太守蒯恩、下邳太守劉鐘，精勇二萬，直指成都。

translations.literal: I therefore order Kuai En, Administrator of Hejian, and Liu Zhong, Administrator of Xiapi, with twenty thousand picked warriors to strike straight at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore order Kuai En, administrator of Hejian, and Liu Zhong, administrator of Xiapi, with twenty thousand picked warriors to strike straight at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 龍驤將軍臧熹，戎卒二萬，進自墊江。

translations.literal: Dragon Courser General Zang Xi, with twenty thousand troops, advances from Dianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Courser General Zang Xi, with twenty thousand troops, advances from Dianjiang.

sentences.zh: 益州刺史朱齡石，舟師三萬，電曜外水。

translations.literal: Zhu Ling, Inspector of Yi Province, with thirty thousand naval forces, flashes like lightning on the outer waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ling, inspector of Yi Province, with thirty thousand naval forces, flashes like lightning on the outer waterways.

sentences.zh: 分遣輔國將軍索懇，率漢中之眾，濟自劍道。

translations.literal: I separately dispatch Pacifying-the-State General Suo Ken, leading the forces of Hanzhong, to cross by the Sword Road.
translations.idiomatic: I separately dispatch Pacifying-the-State General Suo Ken, leading the forces of Hanzhong, to cross by the Sword Road.

sentences.zh: 振威將軍朱客子，提寧州之銳，渡瀘而入。

translations.literal: Quelling-Might General Zhu Kezi, taking the elite of Ning Province, crosses the Lu and enters.
translations.idiomatic: Quelling-Might General Zhu Kezi, taking the elite of Ning Province, crosses the Lu and enters.

sentences.zh: 神兵四臨，天綱宏掩，衡翼千里，金鼓萬張，組甲貝胄，景煥波屬，華夷百濮，雲會霧臻，以此攻戰，誰與為敵！

translations.literal: Divine armies press from four sides, heaven's net spreads wide, banners and wings span a thousand li, ten thousand drums and gongs sound, linked armor and shell helmets gleam in waves upon waves, Chinese and barbarians and the hundred Pu gather like clouds and mist—who could be our enemy in such an assault!
translations.idiomatic: Divine armies press from four sides, heaven's net spreads wide, banners span a thousand li, ten thousand drums sound, linked armor and shell helmets gleam in waves upon waves, Chinese and barbarians and the hundred Pu gather like clouds and mist—with such an assault, who could stand as our enemy!

sentences.zh: 況又奉義而行，以順而動者哉！

translations.literal: All the more when we act in the name of righteousness and move in accord with the Way!
translations.idiomatic: All the more when we act in the name of righteousness and move in accord with the Way!

sentences.zh: 今三陝之隘，在我境內，非有岑彭荊門之險。

translations.literal: Today the passes of the Three Gorges lie within our territory; there is none of the peril Cen Peng faced at Jingmen.
translations.idiomatic: Today the passes of the Three Gorges lie within our territory; there is none of the peril Cen Peng faced at Jingmen.

sentences.zh: 彌入其阻，平衢四達，實無鄧艾綿竹之艱。

translations.literal: Press deeper into the barriers and level highways run in all directions; there is truly none of the hardship Deng Ai met at Mianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Press deeper into the barriers and level highways run in all directions; there is truly none of the hardship Deng Ai met at Mianzhu.

sentences.zh: 山川之形，抑非曩日，攻守難易，居然百倍。

translations.literal: The form of mountains and rivers is not what it was in former days; the ease or difficulty of attack and defense differs by a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: The lay of mountains and rivers is not what it was in former days; the ease or difficulty of attack and defense differs by a hundredfold.

sentences.zh: 當全蜀之強，士民之富，子陽不能自安於庸、僰，劉禪不敢竄命於南中，荊邯折謀，伯約挫銳。

translations.literal: When all Shu was strong and its people and gentry rich, Gongyang could not secure himself in Yong and Bo, Liu Shan dared not flee for his life to the south, Jing Han's plans were broken, and Bo Yue's edge was blunted.
translations.idiomatic: When all Shu was strong and its people and gentry rich, Gongyang could not secure himself in Yong and Bo, Liu Shan dared not flee for his life to the south, Jing Han's plans were broken, and Jiang Wei's edge was blunted.

sentences.zh: 故知成敗有數，非可智延，此皆益土前事，當今元龜也。

translations.literal: Thus one knows success and failure follow a fixed pattern and cannot be prolonged by cunning; these are all earlier events in the land of Yi and are today's great mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows success and failure follow a fixed pattern and cannot be prolonged by cunning; these are all earlier events in Yi Province and are today's great mirror.

sentences.zh: 盛如盧循，強如容超，陵威南海，跨制北岱，樓船萬艘，掩江蓋汜，鐵馬千群，充原塞隰。

translations.literal: As mighty as Lu Xun, as strong as Murong Chao, towering over the southern sea and spanning the northern peaks, ten thousand tower ships covered the river and overflowed the marshes, and a thousand iron cavalry filled the plains and choked the lowlands.
translations.idiomatic: As mighty as Lu Xun, as strong as Murong Chao, towering over the southern sea and spanning the northern peaks, ten thousand tower ships covered the river and overflowed the marshes, and a thousand iron cavalry filled the plains and choked the lowlands.

sentences.zh: 然廣固之攻，陸無完雉；

translations.literal: Yet at the assault on Guanggu not a whole battlement remained on land;
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the assault on Guanggu not a whole battlement remained on land;

sentences.zh: 左裏之戰，水靡全舟。

translations.literal: at the battle of Zuoli, not a whole boat survived on the water.
translations.idiomatic: at the battle of Zuoli, not a whole boat survived on the water.

sentences.zh: 或顯戮京畿，或傳首萬里。

translations.literal: Some were publicly executed in the capital region, others had their heads sent a myriad li.
translations.idiomatic: Some were publicly executed in the capital region, others had their heads sent a myriad li.

sentences.zh: 故知逆順有勢，難以力抗，斯又目前殷鑒，深切著明者也。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that rebellion and compliance follow their own momentum and cannot be resisted by force alone; this too is a recent mirror, clear and unmistakable.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows that rebellion and compliance follow their own momentum and cannot be resisted by force alone; this too is a recent mirror, clear and unmistakable.

sentences.zh: 梁益人士，咸明王化，雖驅迫一時，本非奧主。

translations.literal: The gentry and people of Liang and Yi all understand royal transformation; though driven for a time, they were never truly loyal to a hidden lord.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people of Liang and Yi all understand royal transformation; though driven for a time, they were never truly loyal to a hidden lord.

sentences.zh: 從之淫虐，日月增播，刑殺非罪，死以澤量。

translations.literal: Zong's tyranny grows day by day; punishments and killings fall on the innocent, and the dead are measured by the marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Zong's tyranny grows day by day; punishments and killings fall on the innocent, and the dead are measured by the marsh.

sentences.zh: 而待命寇仇之戮，㩻䧢豺狼之吻，豈不溯誠南凱，延首東雲，普天有來蘇之幸，而一方懷後予之怨。

translations.literal: Yet they await execution at the enemy's hand and crouch before the wolf's maw—how could they not turn in sincerity toward the southern triumph and stretch their necks toward the eastern clouds? All under heaven would know the joy of renewal, while this one region alone harbors resentment at being left last.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they await execution at the enemy's hand and crouch before the wolf's maw—how could they not turn in sincerity toward the southern triumph and stretch their necks toward the eastern clouds? All under heaven would know the joy of renewal, while this one region alone harbors resentment at being left last.

sentences.zh: 王者之師，以仁為本，舍逆取順，爰自三驅，齊斧所加，縱身而已。

translations.literal: The army of a true king takes benevolence as its foundation: reject the rebellious and take the compliant, beginning with the three-sided hunt; where the executioner's axe falls, only the person himself is struck.
translations.idiomatic: The army of a true king takes benevolence as its foundation: reject the rebellious and take the compliant, beginning with the three-sided hunt; where the executioner's axe falls, only the person himself is struck.

sentences.zh: 其有衿甲反接，自投軍門者，一無所問。

translations.literal: Those who come with collars bound and hands tied behind them, surrendering at the camp gate, will be questioned about nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Those who come with hands bound, surrendering at the camp gate, will be questioned about nothing.

sentences.zh: 士子百姓，列肆安堵，審擇吉凶，自求多祐。

translations.literal: Gentry and common people, keep your shops in peace and security; weigh fortune and misfortune and seek your own blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry and common people, keep your shops in peace and security; weigh fortune and misfortune and seek your own blessing.

sentences.zh: 大信之明，皦若朝日，如其迷複奸邪，守愚不改，火燎孟諸，芝艾同爛，河決金堤，淵丘同體，雖欲悔之，亦將何及！

translations.literal: Great faith shines bright as the morning sun. But if you persist in delusion, wickedness, and stubborn folly, then when fire sweeps Mengzhu, mugwort and artemisia burn together; when the river breaks the golden dike, deep pools and mounds share one fate—though you wish to repent, how could it not be too late!
translations.idiomatic: Great faith shines bright as the morning sun. But if you persist in delusion, wickedness, and stubborn folly, then when fire sweeps Mengzhu, mugwort and artemisia burn together; when the river breaks the golden dike, deep pools and mounds share one fate—though you wish to repent, how could it not be too late!

sentences.zh: 九年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died in office.

sentences.zh: 時年四十一。

translations.literal: He was forty-one at the time.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-one.

sentences.zh: 次年，以參伐蜀之謀，追封南昌縣五等子。

translations.literal: The next year, for his counsel in the plan to campaign against Shu, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Viscount of the Fifth Rank of Nanchang County.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, for his counsel in the plan to campaign against Shu, he was posthumously enfeoffed as fifth-rank viscount of Nanchang County.

sentences.zh: 豹子洵

translations.literal: Bao's son Xun
translations.idiomatic: Bao's son Xun

sentences.zh: 子洵，元嘉中，歷顯官，廬陵王紹為南中郎將、江州刺史，年少未親政，洵為長史、尋陽太守，行府州事。

translations.literal: His son Xun, during Yuanjia, held successive eminent offices. When Prince Shao of Luling served as General of the Southern Gentlemen and Inspector of Jiang Province, being young and not yet administering affairs himself, Xun served as Chief Clerk and Administrator of Xunyang, handling headquarters and provincial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xun, during Yuanjia, held successive high offices. When Prince Shao of Luling served as General of the Southern Gentlemen and inspector of Jiang Province, being young and not yet administering affairs himself, Xun served as chief clerk and administrator of Xunyang, handling headquarters and provincial affairs.

sentences.zh: 元嘉末，為吳郡太守。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanjia he became Administrator of Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yuanjia he became administrator of Wu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元兇弑立，加洵建威將軍，置佐史。

translations.literal: When the Traitor Prince seized the throne by regicide, Xun was promoted to Establishing-Might General and given a full staff of assistants and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: When the Traitor Prince seized the throne by regicide, Xun was promoted Establishing-Might General and given a full staff of assistants and clerks.

sentences.zh: 會安東將軍隨王誕起義，檄洵為前鋒，加輔國將軍。

translations.literal: When General Who Pacifies the East Prince Dan of Sui raised a righteous army, he summoned Xun by proclamation to serve as vanguard and promoted him to General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: When General Who Pacifies the East Prince Dan of Sui raised a righteous army, he summoned Xun by proclamation to serve as vanguard and made him general who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 事平，頃之卒，追贈征虜將軍，諡曰貞子。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, he soon after died; posthumously he was given General Who Campaigns Against Barbarians; his posthumous title was Lord Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, he soon died; he was posthumously made general who campaigns against barbarians, with the posthumous title Lord Zhen.

sentences.zh: 長子顗，別有傳。

translations.literal: His eldest son Yi has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Yi has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 少子覬，好學善屬文，有清譽於世。

translations.literal: His younger son Ji loved learning and was skilled at literary composition; he had a pure reputation in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His younger son Ji loved learning and wrote well; he enjoyed a spotless reputation in his day.

sentences.zh: 官至司徒從事中郎、武陵內史，蚤卒。

translations.literal: He reached the posts of Attendant Gentleman on the Minister of Education's staff and Interior Minister of Wuling, and died young.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to attendant gentleman on the Minister of Education's staff and interior minister of Wuling, and died young.

sentences.zh: 洵弟濯，揚州秀才，蚤卒。

translations.literal: Xun's younger brother Zhuo was a Yang Province outstanding youth and died young.
translations.idiomatic: Xun's younger brother Zhuo was a Yang Province outstanding youth and died young.

sentences.zh: 濯弟淑，濯子粲，並有別傳。

translations.literal: Zhuo's younger brother Shu and Zhuo's son Can both have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo's younger brother Shu and Zhuo's son Can both have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 褚叔度

translations.literal: Chu Shudu
translations.idiomatic: Chu Shudu

sentences.zh: 秀之弟淡之，字仲源，亦歷顯官，為高祖車騎從事中郎，尚書吏部郎，廷尉卿，左衛將軍。

translations.literal: Xiuzhi's younger brother Danzhi, styled Zhongyuan, also held successive eminent offices: Attendant-in-Ordinary on the High Ancestor's Chariots and Cavalry staff, Director of the Ministry of the Civil Service in the Secretariat, Commandant of Punishments, and Left Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuzhi's younger brother Danzhi, styled Zhongyuan, also held successive high offices: attendant-in-ordinary on the High Ancestor's chariots and cavalry staff, director of the Ministry of the Civil Service, commandant of punishments, and left guard general.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命，為侍中。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, Danzhi became Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, Danzhi became attendant at court.

sentences.zh: 淡之兄弟並盡忠事高祖，恭帝每生男，輒令方便殺焉，或誘賂內人，或密加毒害，前後非一。

translations.literal: Danzhi and his brothers all loyally served the High Ancestor; whenever Emperor Gong bore a son, they were told to find a convenient occasion to kill him—sometimes by seducing or bribing palace women, sometimes by secretly administering poison; such cases were not just one or two.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi and his brothers all loyally served the High Ancestor; whenever Emperor Gong fathered a son, they were ordered to find a way to kill him—by seducing or bribing palace women, or by secret poison—and this happened again and again.

sentences.zh: 及恭帝遜位，居秣陵宮，常懼見禍，與褚后共止一室，慮有鴆毒，自煮食於床前。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gong abdicated and dwelt in Moling Palace, he constantly feared meeting disaster; he and Empress Chu stayed together in one room, fearing poisoned wine, and cooked his own food before his bed.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Gong abdicated and lived in Moling Palace, he lived in constant fear; he and Empress Chu shared one room, dreading poisoned wine, and cooked his own food beside his bed.

sentences.zh: 高祖將殺之，不欲遣人入內，令淡之兄弟視褚后，褚后出別室相見，兵人乃踰垣而入，進藥於恭帝。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor was about to kill him, not wishing to send men inside, he had Danzhi and his brothers visit Empress Chu; when the empress came out to a separate room to meet them, soldiers then scaled the wall and entered, presenting poison to Emperor Gong.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor meant to kill him but did not wish to send men inside, he had Danzhi and his brothers visit Empress Chu; when the empress stepped into another room to receive them, soldiers climbed the wall, entered, and presented poison to Emperor Gong.

sentences.zh: 帝不肯飲，曰：「佛教自殺者，不得復人身。

translations.literal: The emperor refused to drink and said: "In Buddhism, one who commits suicide cannot regain a human body.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused to drink and said, "In Buddhism, one who takes his own life cannot be reborn in human form.

sentences.zh: 」乃以被掩殺之。

translations.literal: " They then smothered him with a quilt.
translations.idiomatic: " They then smothered him with a quilt.

sentences.zh: 後會稽郡缺，朝議欲用蔡廓，高祖曰：「彼自是蔡家佳兒，何關人事，可用佛。

translations.literal: Later the post of Kuaiji Commandery was vacant; court deliberation wished to use Cai Kuo; the High Ancestor said: "He is simply a fine son of the Cai family—what has that to do with public affairs? Fo can be used.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the post of Kuaiji Commandery fell vacant, court deliberation favored Cai Kuo; the High Ancestor said, "He is simply a fine son of the Cai family—what has that to do with public affairs? Fo will do.

sentences.zh: 」佛，淡之小字也。

translations.literal: " Fo was Danzhi's childhood name.
translations.idiomatic: " Fo was Danzhi's childhood name.

sentences.zh: 乃以淡之為會稽太守。

translations.literal: Danzhi was then made Administrator of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi was then made administrator of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 景平二年，富陽縣孫氏聚合門宗，謀為逆亂，其支黨在永興縣，潛相影響。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingping, the Sun clan of Fuyang County gathered their kinsmen in a gate-association and plotted rebellion; their partisans in Yongxing County secretly coordinated with one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingping, the Sun clan of Fuyang County gathered their kinsmen and plotted rebellion; their partisans in Yongxing County secretly acted in concert.

sentences.zh: 永興令羊恂覺其姦謀，以告淡之；

translations.literal: The Magistrate of Yongxing, Yang Xun, detected their treacherous plot and reported it to Danzhi;
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate of Yongxing, Yang Xun, detected the plot and reported it to Danzhi;

sentences.zh: 淡之不信，乃以誣人之罪，收縣職局。

translations.literal: Danzhi did not believe it and, on a charge of false accusation, arrested the county clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi did not believe him and, charging false accusation, arrested the county clerks.

sentences.zh: 於是孫法亮號冠軍大將軍，與孫道慶等攻沒縣邑，即用富陽令顧粲為令，加輔國將軍。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sun Faliang styled himself Grand General of the Champion Army; with Sun Daoqing and others he attacked and overran the county seat, immediately installing Gu Can, former magistrate of Fuyang, as magistrate and promoting him to General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sun Faliang styled himself grand general of the champion army; with Sun Daoqing and others he overran the county seat, installed the former magistrate of Fuyang, Gu Can, as magistrate, and made him general who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 遣偽建威將軍孫道仲、孫公喜、法殺攻永興。

translations.literal: He dispatched the false Establishing-Might General Sun Daozhong, Sun Gongxi, and Fa Sha to attack Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the false Establishing-Might General Sun Daozhong, Sun Gongxi, and Fa Sha against Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 永興民灟恭期初與賊同，後反善就羊恂，率吏民拒戰，力少退敗。

translations.literal: The Yongxing commoner Zhu Gongqi at first sided with the rebels, then turned to loyalty and went to Yang Xun, leading officials and people to resist; being few in force, they were driven back in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongxing commoner Zhu Gongqi had first sided with the rebels, then turned loyal and joined Yang Xun, leading officials and people to resist; outnumbered, they were driven back.

sentences.zh: 賊用縣人許祖為令，恂逃伏江唐山中，尋復為賊所得，使還行縣事。

translations.literal: The rebels installed a local man, Xu Zu, as magistrate; Xun fled and hid in the Jiang-Tang mountains, but soon was captured again by the rebels and made to return and administer county affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels installed the local man Xu Zu as magistrate; Xun fled and hid in the Jiang-Tang mountains, but was soon captured again and forced to resume county administration.

sentences.zh: 賊遂磐據，更相樹立，遙以鄮令司馬文寅為征西大將軍，孫道仲為征西長史，孫道覆為左司馬，與公喜、法殺等建旗鳴鼓，直攻山陰。

translations.literal: The rebels then held firm positions, setting up one another in office; from afar they made the Magistrate of Mao, Sima Wenyin, Grand General Who Campaigns West; Sun Daozhong, Chief Clerk Who Campaigns West; Sun Daofu, Left Major; and with Gongxi, Fa Sha, and others raised banners and beat drums to attack Shanyin directly.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then dug in, installing one another in office; from afar they made the magistrate of Mao, Sima Wenyin, grand general who campaigns west; Sun Daozhong, chief clerk who campaigns west; Sun Daofu, left major; and with Gongxi, Fa Sha, and others raised banners and drums and marched straight on Shanyin.

sentences.zh: 淡之自假凌江將軍，以山陰令陸邵領司馬，加振武將軍，前員外散騎常侍王茂之為長史，前國子博士孔欣、前員外散騎常侍謝芩之並參軍事，召行參軍七十餘人。

translations.literal: Danzhi personally took the acting title Crossing-the-River General; he had the Magistrate of Shanyin Lu Shao serve as major with the additional title General Who Establishes Martiality; former Extraordinary Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary Wang Maozhi as chief clerk; former Doctor of the Imperial Academy Kong Xin and former Extraordinary Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary Xie Qin-zhi both as military advisers; and summoned more than seventy acting retainers.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi took the acting title crossing-the-river general; he had the magistrate of Shanyin, Lu Shao, serve as major with the additional rank of general who establishes martiality; former extraordinary attendant cavalier-in-ordinary Wang Maozhi as chief clerk; former doctor of the imperial academy Kong Xin and former extraordinary attendant cavalier-in-ordinary Xie Qin-zhi as military advisers; and summoned more than seventy acting retainers.

sentences.zh: 前鎮西諮議參軍孔甯子、左光祿大夫孔季恭子山士在艱中，皆起為將軍。

translations.literal: Former Advising Staff Officer of the Pacify-the-West Army Kong Ningzi and Kong Jigong's son Shan-shi of the Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, though in mourning, were all raised and made generals.
translations.idiomatic: Former advising staff officer of the Pacify-the-West Army Kong Ningzi and Kong Jigong's son Shan-shi, a Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness still in mourning, were both recalled and made generals.

sentences.zh: 遣隊主陳願、郡議曹掾虞道納二軍過浦陽江。

translations.literal: He dispatched Squad Leader Chen Yuan and the Commandery Deliberation Bureau Clerk Yu Daona with two armies to cross the Puyang River.
translations.idiomatic: He sent squad leader Chen Yuan and commandery deliberation bureau clerk Yu Daona with two armies across the Puyang River.

sentences.zh: 願等戰敗，賊遂摧鋒而前，去城二十餘里。

translations.literal: Yuan and the others were defeated; the rebels then drove their vanguard forward to within twenty-odd li of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan and the others were defeated, and the rebels drove forward to within twenty-odd li of the city.

sentences.zh: 淡之遣陸邵督帶戟公石綝、廣武將軍陸允以水軍拒之，又別遣行參軍灟恭期率步軍與邵合力。

translations.literal: Danzhi sent Lu Shao to oversee Gong Shi-chun of the Halberd-Bearers and General of Broad Martial Lu Yun with the water army to resist them; he also separately dispatched the acting retainer Zhu Gongqi with infantry to join forces with Shao.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi sent Lu Shao to command Gong Shi-chun of the halberd-bearers and General of Broad Martial Lu Yun with the water army to resist them, and separately sent the acting retainer Zhu Gongqi with infantry to join Shao.

sentences.zh: 淡之率所領出次近郊。

translations.literal: Danzhi led those under his command out and encamped in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhi led his forces out and encamped in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 恭期等與賊戰於柯亭，大破之，賊走還永興。

translations.literal: Gongqi and the others fought the rebels at Keting and utterly defeated them; the rebels fled back to Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: Gongqi and the others fought the rebels at Keting and routed them; the rebels fled back to Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 遣偽寧朔將軍孫倫領五百人攻錢唐，與縣戍軍建武將軍戰於琦，倫敗走還富陽。

translations.literal: The false General Who Pacifies the Dawn Sun Lun led five hundred men to attack Qiantang; he fought the county garrison's General Who Establishes Martial Prowess at Qi and was defeated, fleeing back to Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: The false general who pacifies the dawn, Sun Lun, led five hundred men against Qiantang; he fought the county garrison's general who establishes martial prowess at Qi, was defeated, and fled back to Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 倫因反善，殺法步帥等十餘人，送首京都。

translations.literal: Lun then turned to the loyal side, killed Fa, Bu-shuai, and more than ten others, and sent their heads to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lun then turned loyal, killed Fa, Bu-shuai, and more than ten others, and sent their heads to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔遣殿中員外將軍徐卓領千人，右將軍彭城王義康遣龍驤將軍丘顯率眾五百東討，司空徐羨之版揚州主簿沈嗣之為富陽令領五百人，於吳興道東出，竝未至而賊平。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Palace Attendant Outside General Xu Zhuo leading a thousand men; Right General Prince Yikang of Pengcheng sent Dragon Soaring General Qiu Xian with five hundred men to campaign east; Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi issued a commission making Yang Province chief clerk Shen Sizhi Administrator of Fuyang leading five hundred men, setting out east from the Wuxing route—they all had not yet arrived when the rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Palace Attendant Outside General Xu Zhuo with a thousand men; Right General Prince Yikang of Pengcheng sent Dragon Soaring General Qiu Xian with five hundred men east to suppress the rebels; Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi commissioned Yang Province chief clerk Shen Sizhi as administrator of Fuyang with five hundred men, marching east from the Wuxing route—all had not yet arrived when the rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守江夷輕行之職，停吳一宿，進至富陽，分別善惡，執送願徙賊餘黨數百家於彭城、壽陽、青州諸處。

translations.literal: Wu Commandery Administrator Jiang Yi, on lighter official business, stopped one night at Wu, advanced to Fuyang, sorted good from evil, arrested and sent Chen Yuan, and relocated several hundred families among the rebels' remnant partisans to Pengcheng, Shouyang, Qing Province, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Commandery administrator Jiang Yi, while on lighter official business, stopped one night at Wu, advanced to Fuyang, sorted the guilty from the innocent, arrested and sent Chen Yuan, and relocated several hundred rebel remnant families to Pengcheng, Shouyang, Qing Province, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 二年，淡之卒，時年四十五。

translations.literal: In the second year Danzhi died; he was forty-five at the time.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Danzhi died, aged forty-five.

sentences.zh: 諡曰質子。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Lord Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Lord Zhi.

sentences.zh: 叔度名與高祖同，故以字行。

translations.literal: Shudu's personal name shared a taboo with the High Ancestor, so he went by his courtesy name.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu's personal name was tabooed because it matched the High Ancestor's, so he was known by his courtesy name.

sentences.zh: 初為太宰琅邪王參軍，高祖車騎參軍事，司徒左西屬，中軍諮議參軍，署中兵，加建威將軍。

translations.literal: At first he was retainer to the Grand Tutor, Prince of Langye; staff officer on the High Ancestor's Chariots and Cavalry headquarters; Left Western Aide to the Minister of Education; advising staff officer of the Center Army; acting head of the center-army section; and given the additional title Establishing-Might General.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was retainer to the Grand Tutor, Prince of Langye; staff officer on the High Ancestor's chariots and cavalry headquarters; left western aide to the Minister of Education; advising staff officer of the center army; acting head of the center-army section; and made Establishing-Might General.

sentences.zh: 從伐鮮卑，盡其誠力。

translations.literal: He followed on the campaign against the Xianbei and gave his utmost loyal effort.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against the Xianbei and gave his utmost loyal effort.

sentences.zh: 盧循攻查浦，叔度力戰有功。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun attacked Chabu, Shudu fought hard and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun attacked Chabu, Shudu fought hard and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 循南走，高祖版行廣州刺史，仍除都督交、廣二州諸軍事、建威將軍、領平越中郎將、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: When Xun fled south, the High Ancestor commissioned him acting Administrator of Guang Province and then formally appointed him Overseer of Military Affairs for Jiao and Guang Provinces, Establishing-Might General, concurrent Commander of the Pacify-the-Yue Gentlemen-of-the-Center, and Administrator of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun fled south, the High Ancestor commissioned Shudu acting administrator of Guang Province and then formally appointed him overseer of military affairs for Jiao and Guang provinces, Establishing-Might General, concurrent commander of the pacify-the-Yue gentlemen-of-the-center, and administrator of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 桓玄族人開山聚眾，謀掩廣州，事覺，叔度悉平之。

translations.literal: A clansman of Huan Xuan, Kaishan, gathered a host and plotted to take Guangzhou by surprise; when the affair was discovered, Shudu entirely pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Kaishan, a clansman of Huan Xuan, gathered a host and plotted to seize Guangzhou by surprise; when the plot was discovered, Shudu suppressed them entirely.

sentences.zh: 義熙八年，盧循餘黨劉敬道窘迫，詣交州歸降。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yixi, Liu Jingdao, a remnant partisan of Lu Xun, was hard pressed and came to Jiao Province to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yixi, Liu Jingdao, a remnant partisan of Lu Xun, was hard pressed and came to Jiao Province to surrender.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史杜慧度以事言統府，叔度以敬道等路窮請命，事非款誠，報使誅之。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Jiao Province Du Huidu reported the matter to the headquarters; Shudu, considering that Jingdao and the others, their road exhausted, were begging for their lives and the matter was not sincere submission, replied ordering them executed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Province inspector Du Huidu reported the matter to headquarters; Shudu judged that Jingdao and the others, their road exhausted, were begging for their lives rather than submitting in good faith, and replied ordering their execution.

sentences.zh: 慧度不加防錄，敬道招集亡命，攻破九真，殺太守杜章民，慧度討平之。

translations.literal: Huidu did not place them under guard; Jingdao gathered fugitives, broke through Jiuzhen, killed the Administrator Du Zhangmin, and Huidu suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Huidu did not place them under guard; Jingdao gathered fugitives, broke into Jiuzhen, killed administrator Du Zhangmin, and Huidu suppressed the rising.

sentences.zh: 叔度輒貶慧度號為奮揚將軍，惡不先上，為有司所糾，詔原之。

translations.literal: Shudu on his own authority demoted Huidu's title to General Who Exerts Yang; the offense was failing to report first—he was impeached by the relevant offices, and an edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu on his own demoted Huidu to general who exerts yang; the offense was acting without prior report—he was impeached by the relevant offices, but an edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 高祖征劉毅，叔度遣三千人過嶠，荊州平乃還。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor campaigned against Liu Yi, Shudu sent three thousand men across the mountain passes; when Jing Province was pacified they returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor marched against Liu Yi, Shudu sent three thousand men across the passes; when Jing Province was pacified they returned.

sentences.zh: 在任四年，廣營賄貨，家財豐積，坐免官，禁錮終身。

translations.literal: During four years in office he widely pursued bribes and goods; household wealth piled up richly; for this he was dismissed from office and imprisoned for life.
translations.idiomatic: During four years in office he widely pursued bribes and goods until his household wealth was great; for this he was dismissed and imprisoned for life.

sentences.zh: 還至都，凡諸舊及有一面之款，無不厚加贈遺。

translations.literal: When he returned to the capital, all old acquaintances and anyone with even one meeting's familiarity—none failed to receive generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned to the capital, every old acquaintance and anyone with even one meeting's familiarity received generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 尋除太尉諮議參軍、相國右司馬。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Advising Staff Officer to the Grand Commandant and Right Major of the Chancellor of State.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made advising staff officer to the Grand Commandant and right major of the chancellor of state.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命，為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, Shudu became Right Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor received the Mandate, Shudu became right guard general.

sentences.zh: 高祖以其名家，而能竭盡心力，甚嘉之。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor, because he came from a famous house yet was able to exhaust his heart and strength, greatly commended him.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor greatly commended him, for though he came from a famous house he had exhausted heart and strength in service.

sentences.zh: 乃下詔曰：「夫賞不遺勤，則勞臣增勸；

translations.literal: He thereupon issued an edict saying: "When rewards do not overlook diligence, toiling ministers are further encouraged;
translations.idiomatic: He then issued an edict: "When rewards do not overlook diligence, toiling ministers are further encouraged;

sentences.zh: 爵必疇庸，故在功咸達。

translations.literal: enfeoffments must match merit, so those with achievement all attain reward.
translations.idiomatic: enfeoffments must match merit, so those with achievement all attain reward.

sentences.zh: 叔度南北征討，常管戎要，西夏不虔，誠著嶺表，可封番禺縣男，食邑四百戶。

translations.literal: Shudu campaigned north and south and constantly managed military essentials; the Western Xia were insincere, and his loyalty was manifest beyond the mountain ranges—he may be enfeoffed as Baron of Panyu County with a fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu campaigned north and south and constantly managed military essentials; the western barbarians were insincere, and his loyalty was manifest beyond the ranges—let him be enfeoffed as baron of Panyu County with a fief of four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 」尋加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: " Soon he was additionally made Regular Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon he was additionally made regular attendant cavalier-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 永初三年，出為使持節、監雍、梁、南、北秦四州，荊州之南陽、竟陵、順陽、義陽、新野、隨六郡諸軍事，征虜將軍，雍州刺史，領寧蠻校尉，襄陽、義成太守。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongchu he went out as Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Supervisor of Yong, Liang, Southern Qin, and Northern Qin Provinces and military affairs for the six commanderies Nanyang, Jingling, Shunyang, Yiyang, Xinye, and Sui of Jing Province; General Who Campaigns Against Barbarians; Inspector of Yong Province; concurrent Commandant Who Pacifies the Barbarians; and Administrator of Xiangyang and Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongchu he went out as bearer of the staff of authority, supervisor of Yong, Liang, southern Qin, and northern Qin and military affairs for Nanyang, Jingling, Shunyang, Yiyang, Xinye, and Sui in Jing Province; general who campaigns against barbarians; inspector of Yong Province; concurrent commandant who pacifies the barbarians; and administrator of Xiangyang and Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 在任每以清簡致稱。

translations.literal: In office he was each time praised for purity and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was repeatedly praised for purity and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 景平二年，卒，時年四十四。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingping he died; he was forty-four at the time.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingping he died, aged forty-four.

sentences.zh: 子恬之嗣，官至南琅邪太守。

translations.literal: His son Tianzhi succeeded; he reached the post of Administrator of Southern Langye.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tianzhi succeeded and rose to administrator of Southern Langye.

sentences.zh: 恬之卒，子昭嗣。

translations.literal: When Tianzhi died, his son Zhao succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzhi died, his son Zhao succeeded.

sentences.zh: 昭卒，子瑄嗣。

translations.literal: When Zhao died, his son Xuan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao died, his son Xuan succeeded.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，國除。

translations.literal: When Qi received the abdication, the fief was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the abdication, the fief was abolished.

sentences.zh: 叔度第二子寂之，著作佐郎，早卒。

translations.literal: Shudu's second son Jizhi was Associate Gentleman of the Composition Office and died young.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu's second son Jizhi was associate gentleman of the composition office and died young.

sentences.zh: 子授，尚太祖第六女琅邪貞長公主，太宰參軍，亦早卒。

translations.literal: His son Shou married the Grand Founder's sixth daughter, Princess Zhen the Long of Langye, served as retainer to the Grand Tutor, and also died young.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shou married the Grand Founder's sixth daughter, Princess Zhen the Long of Langye, served as retainer to the Grand Tutor, and also died young.

sentences.zh: 子淵庶生，宣公主以淵有才，表為嫡嗣。

translations.literal: His son Yuan was born of a concubine; Princess Xuan, because Yuan had talent, petitioned to make him legitimate heir.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yuan was born of a concubine; Princess Xuan, finding Yuan talented, petitioned to make him legitimate heir.

sentences.zh: 淵，昇明末為司空。

translations.literal: Yuan, at the end of the Shengming era, served as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan served as Minister of Works at the end of the Shengming era.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：高祖雖累葉江南，楚言未變，雅道風流，無聞焉爾。

translations.literal: The historian says: Although the High Ancestor's house for generations had dwelt in Jiangnan and Chu speech was unchanged, no word reached there of the refined Way and its elegant flow.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: Although the High Ancestor's house had dwelt in Jiangnan for generations and Chu speech was unchanged, no word reached there of the refined Way and its elegant flow.

sentences.zh: 凡此諸子，並前代名家，莫不望塵請職，負羈先路，將由庇民之道邪。

translations.literal: All these various men were scions of famous houses of former ages; none failed to seek office trailing in his dust, bearing saddles on the road ahead—is it because of the Way of sheltering the people?
translations.idiomatic: All these men were scions of famous houses of former ages; none failed to seek office trailing in his dust, bearing saddles on the road ahead—was it because of the Way of sheltering the people?
